description: Add a record to a list of a Spryloom page that saves data, or update, change or delete a record the signed-in person saved themselves. Match the fields the existing records use. Only when the user asks for that change. Records others saved can be changed only in the page itself.

action.description: update sets only the fields in data and keeps the rest (null removes a field); change replaces the whole record.

data.description: The record, as a JSON object. Needed to add or change.

id.description: The record's id, from page_data. Needed to change or delete.

page.description: The page's address, or its name in your workspace.

name: save_page_record
